plan.title: Live RFQ Extend Submission Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the RFQ Responses tab specified by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Extend Submission Time without submitting a change.
Assert that the expected time-extension window opened.
Assert that the window offers exactly the expected preset and custom scheduling choices.
Assert that the dialog provides a Cancel button.
Assert that the dialog provides an Ok button while no time change has been submitted.
